notes: Population: 4,521 payloads (SatType 'P') launched in 2025 that reached orbit, from GCAT satcat, satcat100k, auxcat and tmpcat; each payload counted once. Excluded: 51 (launch-failure 1, marginal-launch 3, non-standard-PX 46, suborbital-orbit 1); not in the catalogs at all: 18 standard payloads lost in failed launches (ftocat).

Reconciliation: adding the excluded launch-failure, marginal-launch and suborbital payloads back gives 4,526 payloads and 3,194.0 t TotMass, McDowell's own counting method (his stats page: 4,526 payloads, 3,194.0 t).

Launch year = GCAT LDate (UTC) of the carrying launch; ISS/carrier deployments keep the launch year of their cargo flight. Station-deployed payloads: 22; payloads without an own orbit that use their parent's (ISS/deployer/carrier) orbit: 1.

Orbit classes from the canonical orbit: SSO = Polar/SSO (apogee < 2,000 km, i >= 85°); LEO = other apogee < 2,000 km; GTO/GEO = GEO/GTO/HEO/VHEO, apogee >= 30,000 km, e >= 0.5 or period >= 23 h; MEO = other Earth orbits; Beyond = lunar, heliocentric or escape (Status DSO/DSA, deep-space OpOrbit).
Mass = GCAT 'Mass' (wet mass at orbit insertion, excl. attached objects; TotMass not used to avoid double counting). 0 masses imputed (0.0%); 670 (14.8%) are McDowell's own '?' estimates (~±20 %).

Customer rules (first match wins): captive/Starlink: lead owner UCode SPXS (SpaceX Starlink) = 3169; captive/Starlink: Bus 'Starshield' (NRO proliferated, SpaceX-built and -launched) = 89; captive/Kuiper / OneWeb: owner UCode KUIP or ONEWEB, or Program Kuiper/OneWeb = 180; captive/China: State CN/HK/MO = 371; captive/Russia: State RU = 87; institutional-us: NASA Commercial Crew/Cargo spacecraft with a commercial owner = 5; institutional-*: lead owner org class C/D = 167; institutional-*: lead owner A/B but psatcat payload class C/D = 11; open-commercial: remaining class A/B owners = 442.
European institutional = governments/agencies of EU-27, UK, NO, CH, IS, LI plus ESA, EU, EUMETSAT; Other governments = all other non-US, non-CN/RU states.
Andøya band = inclination within [90, 110.6]° (any orbit class): 934 sats (20.7%); open market (excl. captive) 474 of 625; open market <= 700 kg 465 of 580.
Segments: (customer, group, orbit class, 2° inclination bin [lo, hi), mass class with inclusive upper bound); avgMassKg = mean mass of the payloads in the segment, massKg = their total.
Data reflect what flew (historic launches), not addressable future demand; captive = flies on in-house or pre-contracted launchers by policy or contract.
